supersedes: earlier records of this file for 1cba518d7320, 59458cea8b2d and a84e09cda3fe
scope: Container rehearsal only: Debian 13 (debian:trixie) linux/amd64 containers under Rosetta emulation on an aarch64 colima VM. Not hardware, not native x86_64, not production activation or admission.

build_container.network: online (per-container DNS resolver; VM configuration unchanged)

edge_package.producer: Azazel-Edge ae9557d15e5e8347609e2fe2251b03c0a48a86b6 packaging/nexus-core/nexus_core_package.py, cargo build in the same container
edge_package.rehearsal_pin: packaging/offline/edge-artifact.sha256 written from the container-built artifact into the container's copies of the checkout only (git-excluded in the build clone, a copied checkout in the offline container). It stands in for an owner-reviewed pin, which this repository does not ship; it is not one

harness_only_wheels.purpose: PyNaCl for the e2e harness fixtures only. Not in the bundle, not in the production wheelhouse or lock; downloaded unpinned (pynacl==1.6.2 by version only)

build_container.deb_parser_note: control archives of real Debian 13 packages walked by the new ustar/GNU-magic scanner

nested_archive_magic.debian_control_archives: GNU magic (ustar  \0) with an empty extension area, for iproute2 and suricata from Debian 13; accepted by the nested parser only with that area empty

offline_container.network: --network none (only lo; outbound TCP connect failed)
offline_container.image: debian:trixie + python3 python3-venv only (prepared online beforehand, committed to a temporary image and removed afterwards; no compiler, no Nexus files)
offline_container.verifier: tools/offline_bundle.py from a copy of the reviewed checkout (mounted read-only, copied) carrying the rehearsal Edge pin
offline_container.tampered_copy: refused (one byte flipped near the end; gzip CRC check failed in the streamed reader); destination not created, no staging left

installer.command: /bin/sh <tree>/source/packaging/install.sh --without-service-manager, run by install --run-installer as root with PYTHON=<root-owned venv>

e2e_harness_production_venv.command: tools/e2e.py from the reviewed checkout, PYTHONPATH=src:runtime/src as in CI integration-as-root, interpreter = offline venv
e2e_harness_production_venv.failures: Knowledge Lite offline import, Core reserve input path, Integration broker: ModuleNotFoundError nacl (PyNaCl is a dev extra used by the harness fixtures, deliberately not in the runtime wheelhouse); 3 dependent stages not executed; units masked and disabled not executed (no systemd)

e2e_harness_with_harness_only_pynacl.command: same, plus PYTHONPATH entry /opt/harness-site populated by pip install --no-index --target from the harness-only wheels; the production venv was left without PyNaCl
e2e_harness_with_harness_only_pynacl.note: run after the first harness run in the same container

offline_container.sequence: install as root with --run-installer --installer-option=--without-service-manager: extract -> lock check -> Edge artifact hashed against the reviewed pin before any tar parsing -> slots -> venv directory created 0700 exclusively -> root-owned venv -> pip --no-index --require-hashes -> pip check/imports -> recheck against the extraction's manifest_sha256 -> venv ownership -> venv opened to 0755 -> install.sh
offline_container.own_wheels: azazel-nexus and azazel-nexus-runtime are pinned by version only (exact string match against the reviewed pyproject files); their content is built per bundle and is unauthenticated until bundle signing exists
offline_container.without_edge_pin: the unmodified checkout refused the bundle: the Edge slot is refused before parsing when no reviewed pin exists; nothing was left behind
offline_container.recheck_after_install_sh: not re-run in this record; on a84e09c it was refused as designed because install.sh byte-compiles Python inside the tree (recheck is a pre-install gate)
offline_container.what_recheck_does_not_do: recheck is TOCTOU protection only; until bundle signing exists the root install executes bundle-supplied code (the Nexus wheels, pinned by version only, and install.sh)

limitations: Rosetta emulation; x86_64 hardware install not performed
Bundle unsigned and unencrypted; bundle_authenticated false; hashes are integrity, not authenticity
Own Nexus wheels are checked only by version against the reviewed pyproject; their content is covered only by a future bundle signature
Target Python interpreter and python3-venv were provisioned into the offline image online beforehand
No .deb set carried; the deb parser was only exercised on two packages downloaded from the live trixie mirror (not snapshot-pinned)
Harness-only PyNaCl wheels are not hash-pinned and are not part of the product path
systemd stage, activation and services not exercised
Edge package built in a container from a fixed Edge commit and pinned by a rehearsal-only pin; unsigned, health and running not checked, not admitted
